subject: Differences in estimated dur_nightsleep in Part5 output between GGIR 1.9-1 and 1.11-0

messages.author: a3527f6489543e9b
messages.subject: Differences in estimated dur_nightsleep in Part5 output between GGIR 1.9-1 and 1.11-0
parts:
Hi all,
I was wondering if anyone has the following issues when using 1.11-0 version:

1) Looking at the Part 5 day output from the analysis of Axivity AX3 file (cwa file), I noticed that the dur_night_sleep for the first 24h monitoring day (the second row of the output; see attached example) was much shorter with the 1.11-0 than 1.9-1 version (184.25 vs 518.5). It seems like the new version of GGIR did not include the midnight-wake up period into the calculation of sleep duration. Can someone please advise what could be the reason for that? I have attached is the config file which I used to run on both versions of GGIR.

2) I also spotted an error on Part5 output's timestamp with the 1.11-0 on my recent batch of GENEActiv data analysis. For example, the first day of recording data is 19/3/20; however, the timestamp recorded for Day 1 on Part5 output was 18/3/20. I re-run the analysis with the older version of GGIR and confirmed that I didn't make a mistake when initializing the monitors. 

ps. I have accidentally updated my GGIR on RStudio and was wondering if there is a way for me to use the older version instead to ensure consistency in my analysis? 

Thanks and best regards,
John.
